description: This file manages user data export functionality within the TestLink project, including initializing parameters, rendering the export GUI, and executing the export of user data to an XML file.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP Object used for data structures like $args and $gui.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns request parameters and user ID.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares GUI configuration data for the export interface.

methods.name: doExport
methods.description: Performs the export of user data into an XML file using ADODB_XML and triggers file download.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if user has rights to manage users.
